🔬 Rational Approximations of Entangled States (TE Check)

This notebook imports optimization trajectory data, extracts the final states, filters out the ones that are threshold Entangled (TE), and applies a rational approximation to their complex coefficients. It then checks if the resulting rationalized state remains TE.
